name: IMPERIAL FISTS: DARNATH LYSANDER
description: Darnath Lysander wades through his foes like a warship smashing through stormy seas. Raising Rampart – his storm shield – high as he swings the Fist of Dorn, each blow of his hammer reduces enemies to bloody ruin, sweeping whole ranks of warriors from their feet. All the while, Lysander’s obstinate scowl never wavers, his determination absolute.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds Darnath Lysander, a legendary Imperial Fists warrior for your Space Marines armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Clad in a sturdy suit of Terminator armour and equipped with his custom storm shield, Rampart, Lysander wades through incoming firepower before unleashing devastating attacks with his thunder hammer, the Fist of Dorn. He's ideal for leading your force to victory on the tabletop and makes for an excellent painting challenge. Lysander comes with a choice of two heads – helmeted or bare.</br></br>This kit comprises 17 plastic components and 1x Citadel 50mm Round Base. This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
